text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Longer connected explanations across multiple paragraphs","quality":"development","description":"The essay expands ideas with more elaboration and supporting detail rather than staying at the level of brief statements."},{"evidence":"Uses transitions like \"When we go to the beach\" and \"An Example is\"","quality":"coherence","description":"The essay links ideas and examples more clearly, helping the writing move in an organized way from point to point."},{"evidence":"\"I learn from by seeing her cook an egg or make chicken\"","quality":"specific support","description":"The essay includes concrete examples that illustrate the main idea more clearly."},{"evidence":"\"I think Learning from the experience of others is better because...\"","quality":"reasoned explanation","description":"The essay gives more explicit reasoning for claims instead of mainly repeating the same general idea."},{"evidence":"Varied sentence patterns with subordinate clauses and extended sentences","quality":"syntactic variety","description":"The writing shows somewhat more control over sentence structure and uses a wider range of sentence forms."}]}
